convertibility_reason: Uses built-in iATR only, but relies on Trade/SymbolInfo.mqh, Trade/DealInfo.mqh, Trade/PositionInfo.mqh standard library includes for position/deal management. The entry logic is based on a custom price channel (defPcChannel) computed from CopyHigh/CopyLow/CopyClose arrays — not a built-in channel indicator. Position sizing has loss-counting martingale-like reduction logic (LotsOptimized) that needs manual Python reimplementation. Trailing stop logic and the multi-condition channel breakout/reversal signals require careful manual conversion.

derived_values.name: Resist
derived_values.formula: Highest high of last rChannel bars (bar 1 to bar rChannel)

derived_values.name: ResistPrev
derived_values.formula: Highest high of previous rChannel bars (bar 2 to bar rChannel+1)

derived_values.name: Support
derived_values.formula: Lowest low of last rChannel bars (bar 1 to bar rChannel)

derived_values.name: SupportPrev
derived_values.formula: Lowest low of previous rChannel bars (bar 2 to bar rChannel+1)

derived_values.name: atr0
derived_values.formula: ATR[0] current bar value from iATR handle

other_exits: Close buy when hp1[0] >= Resist AND Resist == ResistPrev (same as open buy condition 1, meaning channel breakout triggers both open and close)
Close sell when lp1[0] <= Support AND Support == SupportPrev
Stop loss must be beyond minimum stop level (Sym.StopsLevel()+1); order rejected otherwise

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots==0, use risk-based sizing (FreeMargin*MaxR/1000). If DcF>0, count consecutive losses from deal history and reduce lot: aLots = aLots - aLots*losses/DcF. Lot is then normalized to volume step/min/max.

custom_logic_notes: The price channel (defPcChannel) is a custom Donchian-like channel computed from CopyHigh/CopyLow arrays over rChannel period, not a built-in indicator. Entry conditions are OR-combinations: Long condition 1 = High[1] >= Resist AND Resist==ResistPrev (breakout); Long condition 2 = Close[1] < Resist AND Resist==ResistPrev AND Close[1] > Pivot (pullback in upper channel). Short is symmetric. Exit conditions mirror entry condition 1 only. There is a bug on line 284: CopyLow returns ==1 instead of ==-1, meaning a failed copy would NOT be caught. Trailing stop runs every tick (outside new-bar guard) and only moves SL if new SL is better than open price. The LotsOptimized function counts consecutive losing deals from most recent history and reduces lot size proportionally — this is a loss-scaling anti-martingale that must be reimplemented in Python backtest. SL for sells includes spread adjustment: Resist + ATR + (Ask-Bid).
python_conversion_notes: 1) Reimplement defPcChannel using rolling max/min over rChannel-period windows of High/Low arrays. 2) Entry signals: two OR conditions per direction with Resist==ResistPrev channel-stability gate. 3) ATR-based SL with different formulas for long (Support - ATR) vs short (Resist + ATR + spread). 4) Trailing stop at Trailing points from current price, only activated when SL is beyond open price. 5) Position sizing has two modes: fixed lots or risk-fraction, with loss-counting reduction — need to track consecutive losses in backtest state. 6) Only one position per symbol allowed. 7) New-bar guard means signals evaluated once per bar. 8) Bug in original code line 284 (CopyLow check ==1 instead of ==-1) should be fixed in Python conversion. 9) NormalizeDouble should map to Python round() with _Digits precision. 10) StopsLevel check must be preserved to reject orders where SL is too close.
